cohort: 350 parturients with spontaneous vaginal deliveries and 350 parturients with cephalopelvic disproportion leading to caesarean section
finding: The mean head circumference of babies delivered to women with CPD via caesarean section was significantly greater than those who had vaginal delivery (35.15+-1.5 vs 34.1+-1.8 cm).
birth_weight: Recorded but not specified in abstract
